findings.detail: changed_types lists job_lineage_content_changed, but native producer emits job_lineage_content_change. Other lineage families, including document association, are also outside that explicit filter. The original check therefore does not universally establish its stated no-lineage-mutation claim.
findings.current_evidence_impact: No invalidated native result: all three retained suffixes independently contain only operation/session_granted/session_receipt; complete job_lineage_/board_load_/native_placement_ prefix comparison passes.
findings.remediation: Separate verify_corrected.py uses complete prefixes and wrote a new127-check supplemental summary; original source and summary preserved.

seam_assessment.reservation_forced: ObservingChannel delegates actual.force(metadata), then halts inside the call before NativeJobLineage.append commits; persisted reservation exists while live reducer remains revision1 and rootR1 only.
seam_assessment.native_root_published: Actual native Panel.setChildren assigns its children before firing the named property event; listener seesR1/R2 while source definition remainsR1. Reservation is already durable and reducerrevision2/pending; publication outcome is absent.
seam_assessment.publication_forced: After actual root publication/required invalidations, publication record is forced; halt precedes reducer clearing pending. Fresh replay sees completed publication but original apply remains outcome_unknown.

recovery_assessment.public_mutation_rejections: RECOVERY_REQUIRED global unresolved-operation fence; this does not prove post-reconciliation historical-document rejection or resume behavior.

scope_limits: Direct Bridge.call/native executor paths; no HTTP authentication or MCP exercised
Three process-death seams, not arbitrary listener schedules, generic rollback or host power loss
No later reconciliation/load/resume authority or physical qualification
Runtime.halt bypasses ordinary cleanup; recorded force completion is process-crash evidence, not physical storage power-failure proof
Run report combined metadata mentions an executor gate; implementation uses an armed force observer/native children listener and real native dispatch, not a separate synthetic executor gate
